title: The whole arc: a voice memo at about 19:00 to a site with two faces at 02:19
summary: On 10 November at about 19:00 UTC Dinis asked, by voice, for a separate incident team with its own conductor, repository and site, and pushes live in seconds; at 02:19:08 on 11 November the home page of storm-charles.promptugal.news became the Weather face, with the evidence behind it at data-room/.

Dinis acted nine times in the record: the voice memo, the repository and its name, a yes to the plan, and six spoken directions (~23:40, ~00:30, ~01:28, ~02:10, ~02:20, ~02:50). Everything between is agents, routed by incident.conductor@.

The shape of every round: Dinis speaks; the conductor writes his words into BRIEF.md and the jobs into agents/JOBS.md within minutes and starts sessions; each new agent pushes a key, then a first page, within about ten minutes; rounds follow.
From the first push (21:14:33) to the swap (02:19:08) is 5 h 04 min; by 02:53 the CI record held 363 commits by 24 agents and 210 releases, a push served at the median in 30 s (data/ci/index.json).

What broke and was fixed in the open: the first run failed its own gate; bursts of pushes starved the deploy; twenty agents raced release.sh; three agents still cannot push here and the conductor copies their files across (an ask to Dinis open since 21:20).

shape.step: n, at (UTC; for a commit step, the committer time), at_note, actor {name, kind: person|agent|ci}, in, out, handoff {to, via, evidence_of_handoff}, kind, sha (a commit of this repository unless repo says otherwise), agent_trailer, for[] (the commit's For: trailers), evidence[] (commit | version | file | url), evidence_note
shape.evidence: commit {sha, url}; version {version, run, own_run, served_by, push_to_served_s}: the first CI tag at or after the commit; file {path, section?}; url {url, read_utc}. Entries with "filled": true are written by tools/reporter-fill.mjs from git and data/ci/runs/. evidence: [] with evidence_note means the record holds none.
shape.handoffs: Messages between sessions are not in the repository. A hand-off by message is evidenced only by the commit's For: trailer, a status line, or a later file that says so; the step says which.
shape.person: A person's step is where Dinis acted. His words are known only as incident.conductor@ wrote them down in BRIEF.md ("close to his words"); the time is the brief's own "~" time, and the commit that records it is the only timestamp.
